name: Zomato
description: The Zomato MCP server brings India's largest food ordering experience directly into Claude. Discover restaurants near you based on your taste, browse menus with up-to-date pricing and ratings, and build your cart in seconds. Place orders, track deliveries in real time, and pay securely with QR codes, all in one conversation. From craving to doorstep, every step of the ordering journey is collapsed into a single AI-powered workflow.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Zomato to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Zomato to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp-server.zomato.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Zomato MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Zomato provides these MCP tools: create_cart, checkout_cart, get_saved_addresses_for_user, get_restaurant_menu_by_categories, get_menu_items_listing, get_order_history, get_order_tracking_info, get_cart_offers, get_restaurants_for_keyword, bind_user_number, and bind_user_number_verify_code.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Zomato?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Zomato in commerce-shopping on the Manufact MCP catalog include EbooksDepository, ecoExperten Energieausweis, PHS Pallets, Promotion Pros Catalog, and RCO-A2A.
Zomato requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Zomato is developed by Eternal Limited. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
